title: Configuration
text: Define system simulation settings, {Temperature} sets Global noise temperature 290.0 K; {Automatically select fundamental tones and harmonic order}, {Fundamental tones}, {Harmonic order}, {Total simulation frequencies: Computed at simulation time} sets the displays number for simulation frequencies, {Step size} sets the time step for fixed step solver configuration, {Envelope bandwidth} sets the maximum simulated envelope bandwidth, {Simulate noise} sets the globally enable or disable noise modeling, {Use default random number generator} sets the default pseudorandom noise stream for RF Blockset, {Noise seed} sets the seed of the independent pseudo random number, {Samples per frame} sets the number of samples in each channel of input signal to Inport, {Normalize Carrier Power} sets the normalize power of carrier signal, {Enable input interpolation filter} sets the automatic interpolation of lower rate baseband signal to higher rate RF, {Transient analysis} sets the fixed-step solver of RF Blockset, {Approximate transient as small signal} sets the small subset of frequencies for transient small signal, {Use all steady-state simulation frequencies for small signal analysis}, {Small signal frequencies} sets the frequencies for small signal transient simulation, {Populate Frequencies} sets the tool to choose small signal transient frequencies, {Relative tolerance} sets the relative newton tolerance for system variables, {Absolute tolerance} sets the absolute newton tolerance for system variables, {Maximum iterations} sets the number iterations required for convergence, {Error estimation} sets the check for error of convergence in system variables 2-norm over all and {Restore Default Settings} sets the restore newton solver to default values. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Automatically select fundamental tones and harmonic order
params.values: Automatically select fundamental tones and harmonic order on (default) | off

params.name: Fundamental tones
params.values: Fundamental tones of set of simulation frequency vector of positive integers in Hz

params.name: Harmonic order
params.values: Harmonic order for each fundamental tone vector of positive integers

params.name: Total simulation frequencies: Computed at simulation time
params.values: Displays number for simulation frequencies button

params.name: Step size
params.values: Time step for fixed step solver configuration 1e-6 (default) | scalar in seconds

params.name: Envelope bandwidth
params.values: Maximum simulated envelope bandwidth 1 MHz (default) | scalar in Hz

params.name: Simulate noise
params.values: Globally enable or disable noise modeling on (default) | off

params.name: Use default random number generator
params.values: Default pseudorandom noise stream for RF Blockset sources on (default) | off

params.name: Noise seed
params.values: Seed of the independent pseudo random number stream 0 (default) | scalar positive integer

params.name: Temperature
params.values: Global noise temperature 290.0 K | scalar integer in kelvin

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Number of samples in each channel of input signal to Inport block 1 | positive scalar integer

params.name: Normalize Carrier Power
params.values: Normalize power of carrier signal on (default) | off

params.name: Enable input interpolation filter
params.values: Automatic interpolation of lower rate baseband signal to higher rate RF signal on (default) | off

params.name: Transient analysis
params.values: Fixed-step solver of RF Blockset environment Auto (default) | NDF2 | Trapezoidal Rule | Backward Euler

params.name: Approximate transient as small signal
params.values: Choose small subset of frequencies for transient small signal analysis off (default) | on

params.name: Use all steady-state simulation frequencies for small signal analysis
params.values: Choose all steady-state simulation frequencies on (default) | off

params.name: Small signal frequencies
params.values: Frequencies for small signal transient simulation scalar | vector

params.name: Populate Frequencies
params.values: Tool to choose small signal transient frequencies button

params.name: Relative tolerance
params.values: Relative newton tolerance for system variables 1e-3 (default) | real positive finite scalar

params.name: Absolute tolerance
params.values: Absolute newton tolerance for system variables 1e-6 (default) | real positive finite scalar

params.name: Maximum iterations
params.values: Number iterations required for convergence 10 (default) | real positive integer scalar

params.name: Error estimation
params.values: Check for error of convergence in system variables 2-norm over all variables (default) | Each variable separately

params.name: Restore Default Settings
params.values: Restore newton solver to default values button
